title: Protect banking secrets
text: Do not disclose OTPs, PINs, passwords or card security codes to someone contacting you. Independently verify requests using a known bank channel. An account-blocking or KYC warning can be used to pressure a recipient.

title: Unverified apps and permissions
text: Unverified application links distributed through messages can impersonate legitimate services. Check the publisher and requested permissions. Avoid installing an app simply because an unknown caller or message directs you to do so.

title: Remote access and screen sharing
text: Screen-sharing and remote-access tools can expose private information and device actions to another person. A request to install such a tool during an unsolicited financial conversation warrants independent verification.

title: Report financial cyber fraud in India
text: If you suspect financial cyber fraud, promptly contact your bank and preserve the original communication and transaction details. The national reporting portal is cybercrime.gov.in; 1930 provides assistance for financial cyber fraud complaints.

title: RIDSca evidence interpretation policy
text: AI-generated or edited media is not automatically a scam. No reputation match does not prove safety. A synthetic-content classifier score is not the fraction of a file generated by AI. Missing checks require explicit uncertainty.
